task: Core #1186 U10A2-F3 atomic four-source Digital Office privacy and RLS hardening migration lineage (0048-0051)

assuranceCeiling.rationale: Four chronological privacy migrations are a single high-risk data/authorization dependency unit. The earliest source defines participant-only read predicates but temporarily exposes actor-parameterized read function to authenticated, while final 0051 revokes that privilege and uses signed-in-user private RLS helper. All four must be present in one reviewed source chain; no DB rollout or hosted Fresh Install claims.

acceptanceCriteria: Append canonical source-byte-identical 0048-0051 Office privacy migrations after verified 0047 without altering historic baseline or superseded plan-sync guards.
First 0048 adds office_thread_participants and participant-aware policies, with source provenance SHA256 and service-role audited mutation functions.
0049 eligibility and private leave semantics and 0050 private author-read trigger preserve per-tenant membership boundaries.
0051 revokes browser access to actor-parameterized public.can_read_office_thread_v1, and ensures SELECT policy depends on private.current_user_can_read_office_thread_v1 of auth.uid().
Regression tests require all four SQL files and the final 0051 hardening together, with exact source body byte/hash, chronological ordering and no unreviewed interim browser-RPC authority.
The Office source lineage must report exactly seven further missing active prerequisites, still blocked; two obsolete hard-coded Alap Team Chat imports remain explicitly forbidden.
Customer baseline remains snapshot-reviewed with freshInstallProofRequired true and proofContractSha256 null; never declare runtime, hosted or Pro Office release ready.
No real Supabase target, staging, platform, production, Vercel, or private customer information is mutated.
nonGoals: No hosted Fresh Install, zero-tenant seed or staging SQL write.
No merging an incomplete four-migration intermediate chain or claiming full Pro Office operational readiness.
invariants: Canonical original Office migration source bytes are immutable and prove same-order SQL lineage.
Authenticated browser cannot call public actor-parameterized Office thread visibility helper after final source 0051.

Known Supabase target projects are not modified.
forbiddenStates: One, two or three of four privacy source files shipped as ready without 0051 final helper closure.
Authenticated browser gains alternative-actor existence probes via public read helper.
Customer baseline manifest claims READY before real disposable Fresh Install and tenant/RLS proof.
Office replay accepts obsolete teamChat/customerEmail fixed-list plan sync sources.

alternatives.summary: Append all four reviewed, unmodified privacy source migration bodies in strict order and prove the final 0051 helper exposure closure as one release-bound source unit.
alternatives.reason: Captures the natural SQL dependency and enforces the final browser actor-parameterized RPC revocation before any hosted execution.

alternatives.summary: Release only 0048 foundation independently and leave the final 0051 helper exposure closure for a subsequent operation.

specialistReviews.finding: Initial privacy source grants authenticated execute on a public actor-parameterized SECURITY DEFINER read function, potentially enabling another-user visibility probing.
specialistReviews.resolution: Treat all four migrations as indivisible: final 0051 revokes public authenticated execute, and tests fail if actor-parameterized RPC remains callable or final policy absent.

specialistReviews.finding: Participant backfill, audit-write RPC and read-state trigger depend on legacy 0001-0047 table/column/function shape and may fail at database execution time.
specialistReviews.resolution: Retain exactly canonical source bytes and fail closed until empty-target hosted PostgreSQL 17+ replay and signed-in actor GRANT/RLS proof; no staging or production writes.

specialistReviews.finding: Office private-participant access must not modify normal Alap support/customer communication or Team Chat plan grants.
specialistReviews.resolution: Scope only customer baseline privacy SQL and source tests; verify normalized 0014 and Alap grant prohibition 0046 stay untouched.

specialistReviews.finding: Static proof of all four source SQL files does not exercise service-role RPC or authenticated cross-tenant RLS in a real database.
specialistReviews.resolution: Enforce snapshot-reviewed with null proof and leave parent #1186/#1228 OPEN; require disposable Fresh Install role tests before any merge/release claim.

specialistReviews.finding: Office actor/tenant privacy migrations affect merchant admin operation permissions and audit workflows in addition to database schema authority.
specialistReviews.resolution: Expand Known Failure scope to admin-operations and preserve the existing admin audit/service-role mutation contracts in all 0048-0051 source bodies and CI regression checks.

challenge.scenario: Operator applies source 0048 on a live shared DB but forgets later 0051 actor-parameterized RPC revocation.
challenge.finding: An authenticated browser could invoke public.can_read_office_thread_v1 with another user's UUID and probe participant information.
challenge.resolution: Review as inseparable 0048-0051 source DAG; reject partial chains and require final 0051 authenticated EXECUTE revocation and private current-user helper in tests.

challenge.scenario: Actor tries to join a private tenant conversation through a forged instance id or inactive delegation.
challenge.finding: A service-role security-definer Office mutation might skip membership constraints and permit cross-tenant thread access.
challenge.resolution: Preserve original 0048 office_active_store_member_v1 and office_active_participant_v1 checks and defer behavior acceptance to real tenant matrix proof.

challenge.scenario: One privacy migration is truncated while its expected filename and provenance comments are retained.
challenge.finding: A text-only filename check would falsely claim schema completeness and omit participant or policy protections.
challenge.resolution: Check exact full canonical SHA256 and source body equivalence for every individual migration in generated customer baseline SQL.

challenge.scenario: Migration 0051 grants current-user private read helper but leaves public actor-param helper open to authenticated callers.
challenge.finding: Browser-facing PostgREST could still invoke the public helper independently of the RLS policy even if policy selection is tenant-bound.
challenge.resolution: Tests require explicit authenticated revoke and service_role-only grant for public.can_read_office_thread_v1 and strict current_user policy expressions.

challenge.scenario: A previous Team Permissions regression expects 0047 to be the last customer migration after new 0051 privacy SQL.
challenge.finding: Valid additive migrations would produce a false failure and could cause a developer to delete historical test coverage.
challenge.resolution: Update last-migration assertion to 0051 while preserving ordered 0047 and immutable source provenance, with complete 52-file baseline count.

challenge.scenario: The Office source-lineage gate counts four new migration files as complete Digital Office deployment proof.
challenge.finding: Source parity does not establish SQL replay validity, tenant row policies or active service-worker authorization in real Supabase.
challenge.resolution: Source-lineage decision remains BLOCKED for seven active missing sources and realDatabaseProof NOT_EVALUATED, and manifest stays snapshot-reviewed.

challenge.scenario: An older plan-sync SQL file is reintroduced under a different name among newly added Office privacy migration files.
challenge.finding: Legacy fixed-list entitlement replacement might restore forbidden Alap Team Chat after 0046 despite modern privacy controls.
challenge.resolution: Keep and run F2 negative renamed replay and forbiddance tests for both superseded historical migration bodies unchanged.

challenge.scenario: Someone attempts to resume the inactive Fresh Install project or modify occupied staging before full source DAG is implemented.
challenge.finding: Shared or nonempty tenant state could be altered by source-only migrations without an explicit disposable target preflight.
challenge.resolution: Perform only GitHub source/test operations and CI; prohibit any database write or target restoration until separate fully verified empty-target authorization.

operationalIntelligence.problemStatement: First four modern Digital Office privacy SQL predecessors are absent from canonical customer Fresh Install. Source 0048 introduces temporary browser-callable actor-parameterized thread read function, while 0051 closes exposure; copying one source in isolation is an unsafe partial migration. Development Guard identified both database-schema and admin-operations authorities, requiring the expanded failure set and negative knowledge before any SQL implementation.

Negative regression blocks omission or tamper of any of the four and blocks absence of final 0051 actor-parameterized RPC closure.
Existing team-permissions 0047 history remains intact and customer baseline manifest remains unverified until real hosted Fresh Install.
